reading.title: From Waking Up to Leaving Home
reading.text: When the alarm rings, Yusuf wakes up and gets up. He tries not to yawn, then stretches and takes a shower. After he brushes his teeth and gets dressed, he has time to eat breakfast and pack lunch before he leaves home. At the table, he takes time to eat and drink. He chews each bite before he can swallow, then takes a final sip of coffee before work.

reading.title: Daily Action Verbs 2: A Practical Daily Routine
reading.text: A working adult moves through a normal day one task at a time. In the morning, the person may gulp, bite, taste, lick, and slurp.
